description: Περιφέρεια Κρήτης: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Περιφέρεια Κρήτης. Coverage: Περιφέρεια Κρήτης. The listing groups 38 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Χάρτης Πλημμύρας 13-11-2020 - Τζερμιάδο Λασιθίου - Υποδομές Δικτύου Με; Χάρτης Πλημμύρας 13-11-2020 - Αδελιανός Κάμπος Ρεθύμνου - Υποδομές Δικ; Χάρτης Πλημμύρας 13-11-2020 - Βωλεώνες Ρεθύμνου - Υδρογραφία (Γραμμές); Χάρτης Πλημμύρας 13-11-2020 - Τζερμιάδο Λασιθίου - Υδρογραφία (Γραμμές. Formats seen: XML, GEOJSON, KML, SHAPE-ZIP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
